title: Dragging a brush/vector shape shows no live preview during the move (only commits on mouse-up)
description:
REPRO (confirmed on :1420, HEAD ecdbd15): draw a shape (brush stroke or tool rect/oval) on the stage, switch to the Selection tool, pointerdown on it and pointermove WITHOUT pointerup. MID-DRAG the shape stays rendered at its ORIGINAL position and does NOT follow the cursor — there is no live drag preview. On pointerUP it jumps to the correct final position. Empirical e2e (scratch spec, since removed): a tool-drawn rect at orig box had ~19764 drawn px; MID-DRAG orig=19872 / dragged-target=~324 (still at origin, nothing at target); AFTER-UP orig=3564 / target=19764 (moved only on release). Geometry centroid via __flashTest.getDocument confirms: rect cx=116.8 unchanged mid-drag, cx=316.8 (+200) only after up. So the live drag-PREVIEW render is missing; only the final commit shows.

SCOPE: NOT brush-specific. Affects ALL plain vector shapes (DrawingObject brush strokes AND ShapeDisplayObject tool rect/oval) — both live in shapeDisplayObjects and take the same drag path. Symbol instances / text are unaffected (they still use the live selectionDragRef path). Any plain vector shape drag with the Selection tool is broken.

ROOT CAUSE (packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx + Shell.tsx):
- Shell.tsx:1110  partialSelectEnabled = (toolState.activeTool === 'selection') — ALWAYS true for the Selection tool (planar merge-by-default).
- StageArea.tsx:2595-2616 (pointerdown): when partialSelectEnabled, clicking a shape arms subSplitDragRef (split-on-move) and RETURNS — it does NOT arm the whole-object selectionDragRef.
- StageArea.tsx onMouseMove: NO handling of subSplitDragRef during pointermove. subSplitDragRef.current is referenced ONLY at pointerdown (2607, arm) and pointerup (3258-3266, commit). onSubSplitMove(...) is called ONLY on mouse-UP (3263), and only after >3px. So the doc geometry never updates per-move -> nothing re-renders -> invisible drag.
- StageArea.tsx render (3984-4004): the subSelection halo is drawn at target.x/target.y (un-dragged); no live drag offset applied to artwork or halo.
- Contrast: the legacy whole-object path (selectionDragRef) DOES render live — onMouseMove 3083-3199 calls onShapeMove(id,dx,dy) every pointermove (3196) and re-seeds the drag (3198). That path is now only reached when partialSelectEnabled is false (never, for the Selection tool).

REGRESSION: yes. subSplitDragRef / split-on-move introduced in d85fee8 (task 1321, P3 partial selection). partialSelectEnabled forced always-on for the Selection tool in 58ac1d3 (task 1323, P5 merge-by-default cutover). Before 1321/1323 a Selection-tool drag used selectionDragRef and rendered live every move.

FIX DIRECTION: render the dragged shape at its live offset on EVERY pointermove, for all shape types incl. DrawingObject. Options: (a) in onMouseMove, when subSplitDragRef is active and cursor moved >3px, compute the live split+translate and push a transient (non-history) doc each move so the artwork follows the cursor (commit to history only on pointerup, as today); or (b) plumb a live drag-offset into the renderer (translate the selected fill-region/segment geometry + halo by the current dx/dy) without mutating the doc until release. Mirror the live cadence of the legacy selectionDragRef path. Keep the >3px click-vs-drag threshold so a plain click still just selects. ACCEPTANCE: an e2e that pointerdown+pointermoves (no pointerup) on a drawn rect AND a brush stroke and asserts the artwork is at the DRAGGED offset MID-DRAG (not just after release); + a test that a click without drag still selects without moving.
